moments.title: THE MISS
moments.history: Gary Anderson missed a late field goal with Minnesota leading 27-20 in the NFC Championship Game. Chris Chandler took Atlanta from its own 29 and found Terance Mathis for the tying touchdown with 49 seconds left. Morten Andersen later kicked the winning field goal in overtime. The Falcons beat the Vikings 30-27 at the Metrodome and reached Super Bowl XXXIII.
moments.goal: Rally Chris Chandler's Falcons, then win with Morten Andersen.
moments.stadium_note: The real building (the retail H. H. H. Metrodome).
moments.evidence: Situation from the cited sources (1998 has no nflverse play-by-play). Timeouts are in no source: 3 and 3 is INFERRED. Sources differ on the kick (38 yards: NFL.com and the Falcons; 39 yards: Wikipedia, which also has the clock stopped at 2:11 before the kick and the ball wide with 2:07 left); the Falcons' drive of 71 yards from their 29 with 2:07 left agrees in all of them.
